'''Mindor''', also known as '''Taspan I''', was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] with vast landmasses covered in grasslands. It had little to offer the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] community other than its landmasses, which would have been ideal for [[Farm/Legends|farming]]. Mindor had four medium sized [[Moon/Legends|moons]] in very close proximity to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

==History==
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3680 BBY]],<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> [[Fideltin Rusk]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] to a [[Parent/Legends|pair]] of [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrians]] who lived in a [[Chagrian colony|colony]] of pacifists<ref name="Passive Resistance">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Sergeant Rusk|Passive Resistance}}</ref> on Mindor.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], [[Sentry droid/Legends|patrol droids]] of Mindor's government were presumably sabotaged due to the fact that they have ignored orders and went astray.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Dereliction of Duty}}</ref>

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5.5 ABY]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Fenn Shysa]]'s [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]] [[Battle of Mindor|fought]] the forces of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Cronal|Shadowspawn]] to the last man on the battlefields of this world. The battle devastated the planet, and the extreme loss of life convinced Skywalker to resign his commission.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] were also on the planet at the time, and shared a stale meal on the field after the battle, surrounded by dead [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. Han Solo later recalled the harsh battle when he kidnapped Leia shortly before [[Wedding of Han Solo and Leia Organa/Legends|their wedding]].<ref name="The Courtship of Princess Leia">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Oh, sure, Mindor, whatever. Who cares, anyway? If I want to call it Mindar, who's gonna argue? You? How about you, Princess?|Han Solo, to Chewbacca and Leia Organa|<ref name="Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>}}
In ''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]'', Mindor is misspelled as "Mindar." [[Leland Chee]] stated on [[February 23]], [[2007]] in the "Welcome some BCaT VIPs" thread on the [[StarWars.com]] message boards that Mindar is to be treated as a misspelling of Mindor, as all other sources at the time spell the planet's name with an 'o'.<ref>{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=4215#16327721|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2007-02-23|time=10:11 AM|quote=For our purposes, we've determined that Mindar is a misspelling of Mindor. Maybe Han was thinking in an Alderaanian accent.}}</ref>

This misspelling is given a canonical backing in ''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]'', when at one point Han refers to the planet as "Mindar" and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] corrects him, prompting Han to retort that he'll call the planet what he likes.

The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Mindor in the [[Kanchen sector/Legends|Kanchen sector]], which is actually located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. ''Star Wars: Rebellion'' also misspells the planet as "Mindar."
